svg.title: Figure 3-1: situations by zone
svg.desc: A grid with the fifteen situations down the side and the zones across: cells filled green where nobody is exposed, teal where briefed staff are, red where the public is, grey where the situation inherits its parent; the public-floor column is hatched as excluded; the WP-C-06 scenarios of each situation are listed at the right.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 3-1 Situations by zone, coloured by who is exposed there

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A cell is filled where the situation of §3 occurs in that zone of WP-C-02; the task IDs are written in it. The public floor is hatched: excluded at BL-001.
